messages:
incident-bot: PAGE | Sev2 detected for tenant=hydra-fin (enterprise VPC, dedicated-pool). Symptoms: increased 5xx rate on inference, traces missing for requests after 12:34 UTC. Paging oncall: @jordan @riley-eng-infra

jordan: on it. seeing the alert, any initial impact metrics? customer-facing?

carla-support: Hydra Financial reports errors in their dashboard, escalation opened — CS already informed them we're investigating. They say traces/logs for customer request IDs are blank.

anika: I can query our trace index. running quick count for tenant_id=hydra-fin since 12:00...

anika: query: SELECT count(*) FROM traces WHERE tenant_id='hydra-fin' AND timestamp > '2026-03-15T12:00:00Z'

anika: result: 342 spans before 12:34, 0 spans after 12:34; metrics still show requests hitting dedicated pool (latency/5xx).

mike: that suggests forwarding/ingest side for spans dropped, not the model runtime. I'll tail forwarder logs on the dedicated pool.

mike: command: kubectl -n obs-forwarder logs deploy/forwarder-hydra --tail=200 | grep "hydra-fin"

mike: seeing ERROR entries: "drop_span: missing tenant-mapping for pool-hydra" repeated.

riley-eng-infra: hmm. We rolled forwarder v3.2.1 at 12:31 UTC to fix a memory reg, could be a mapping change. Any config diff?

mike: checked config: mapping rule "tenant_id_header" is empty after deploy. previous release had explicit mapping. suspect the helm values override removed it.

luis-sre: can we enable a fallback bridge to the shared aggregator to recover visibility quickly? we should avoid touching production routing if possible, but need traces back for debug.

jordan: agreed. mitigation priority: 1) restore trace ingestion for hydra-fin, 2) keep runtime serving stable, 3) notify customer with ETA.

anika: two-path proposal: A) toggle LEGACY_TRACE_BRIDGE=true on forwarder to use header-based fallback (fast, config toggle). B) if that fails, add temporary sidecar on dedicated pool nodes to mirror spans to global ingest (requires infra change). A is much quicker.

riley-eng-infra: I can do A via SSM/helm patch. Preparing commands.

riley-eng-infra: kubectl -n obs-forwarder set env deploy/forwarder-hydra LEGACY_TRACE_BRIDGE=true && kubectl rollout restart deploy/forwarder-hydra

mike: will monitor logs after toggle. also capturing current span samples for replay if needed.

prodpager: Reminder: shift handoff in 30m. Please include runbook steps in handoff message.

mike: logs show bridge attempts starting, then: INFO bridge: fallback enabled for tenant=hydra-fin -> forwarding to shared-agg

anika: trace index starting to show new spans. count after toggle: ~120 spans in last 2 minutes. good sign.

carla-support: I'll update Hydra Fin with interim note: we have partial trace visibility restored via a temporary fallback. Engineers are working on a permanent fix; ETA 1 hour.

jordan: assign ticket and link rollback steps. creating incident ticket INC-2026-3489 and adding runbook checklist.

jordan: runbook snippet added to ticket: 1) set LEGACY_TRACE_BRIDGE=true, 2) monitor traces index for tenant, 3) if unstable, enable mirrored-sidecar plan (infra). 4) roll back forwarder release to v3.2.0 if mapping loss persists.

luis-sre: note for postmortem: deployment validation didn't catch helm value removal. add a test for tenant mapping presence in deploy CI.

riley-eng-infra: I'm going to patch the helm chart to reintroduce tenant_id_header and open PR. will coordinate with deploy freeze if we need safe rollout.

mike: while we patch, I'm keeping the fallback toggled. latency/5xx on runtime unchanged — only observability gap was affected.

sam-ml: ML note: we should verify KV cache isn't causing request duplication when fallback is active. running quick checks on request ids and model logits.

anika: please capture a few trace examples and share with Hydra for verification once full visibility is restored.

carla-support: Hydra acknowledges interim note, asked for timeline. I told them 1 hour for a permanent fix, they're satisfied for now but want updates every 15m.

jordan: handoff plan: I'll be off in 25m. luis, can you take second-stage oncall if the fallback regresses? add to runbook: contact list and escalation numbers.

luis-sre: taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring until forwarder helm PR merged and rollout validated.

riley-eng-infra: PR opened: infra/forwarder-helm#412 — reintroduce tenant_id_header default. target merge after quick e2e test.

mike: final check: traces stable for 20m, counts approx normal. closing active mitigation but keeping incident open until PR merges and we verify one deploy cycle.

carla-support: I'll send a customer update: visibility restored via fallback; permanent fix in progress; will confirm after change validated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE | INC-2026-3489 status=mitigation_active owner=jordan -> handoff=luis-sre; impacted=Hydra Financial (enterprise VPC, dedicated pool); observability=partial-restored

luis-sre: acknowledged handoff. I'll ping if regression. added checklist to ticket and set next update in 15m.

jordan: thanks team. I'll add a short blameless note for the postmortem and include suggested CI check. back after handoff.

incident-bot: NOTE | Escalation timer set: 60m. Postmortem reminder queued."
